issue.title: Release Schedule for 32.0
issue.body:
Here is a proposed release schedule for `v32.0`, the next major release of Bitcoin Core.
The dates are set to target a release in early October 2026.

## 2026-08-06 ✅
- Open Transifex translations for `v32.0` - #35915
- Soft translation string freeze (no large or non-critical string changes until release)
- Finalize and close translations for `v30.0`

## 2026-08-20 ✅
- Feature freeze (bug fixes only until release)
- Translation string freeze (no more source language changes until release)

## 2026-09-10 :construction:
- Anything needed before branch-off, see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/release-process.md
- Split off `32.x` branch from `master`
- Start RC cycle, tag and release `v32.0rc1`
- Start merging for `33.x` on `master` branch

## 2026-10-10 :construction:
- Tag `v32.0` (aim).

If any specific dates are a problem for you, please leave a comment.
